items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My daddy had a lot there... [INTERVIEWEE] He had a lot on Pritchett Place and Dublin.

ctx.x: Delfast Street. Oh yeah, yeah. Well I tell you what about over that section there.
